1\. How to read this document
=============================

This is the working map of UAP as it will behave in production: every page, how you reach it, every button on it, what the button does, and which page you land on next. It complements the App Flow (journeys and state machines) by going down to the screen and button level.

### Notation

| **Mark** | **Meaning** |
| --- | --- |
| route | Web address inside the staff app, for example /procurement/orders/\[id\]. \[id\] is the record being opened. |
| Access | The scope needed to see the page. Roles in brackets (SA, MG, PI, IS, FS, AT, QI) show who normally has it; the Super Admin has no business scopes. |
| \[L\] | Writes rows to the stock ledger |
| \[GL\] | Queues accounting postings (journal entries are created by the background worker) |
| \[N\] | Sends an in-app notification |
| \[E\] | Sends an email |
| \[AP\] | Creates an approval request when the configured rule matches |
| \[J\] | Starts a background job (PDF, report, import, email) |
| Phase 2 / 3 | Button exists in the design but ships in that phase (PRD section 5.3) |

### Rules that apply to every page and button

*   **Hidden versus disabled:** a button the user’s scopes do not allow is hidden. A button that is allowed but not valid for the record’s current status is disabled, and its tooltip names the reason and, where possible, links to the fix.
*   **Audit:** every button that changes data writes an audit entry (who, when, before and after). This is not repeated in the tables below.
*   **Drafts:** documents in draft autosave every few seconds and show “Saved”. Buttons that post (receipts, issues, dispatches, landed cost, journals) never autosave and always show a confirmation that lists exactly what will be written.
*   **Safe repeats:** posting buttons are idempotent. Double-clicking or retrying after a network drop cannot create duplicate rows.
*   **Conflicts:** if someone else saved first, a banner appears (“Updated by \[name\] at \[time\]”) with Reload and Compare; nothing is overwritten silently.
*   **Destructive actions** (cancel, void, reverse, scrap) need a reason and a confirmation. Anything that touches a closed accounting period is blocked or sent for approval.
*   **Unsaved changes:** leaving a page with edits shows “Leave without saving?”.
*   **Every document page** has the same bones: breadcrumb, header with number, status chip and the next valid action, tabs for its content, a Documents tab for attachments, and a Timeline tab with events and audit entries (for users with the scope).
*   **Shortcuts:** Ctrl/Cmd+K command palette, / focuses the list filter, G then a letter jumps to a module, Esc closes drawers, Enter opens the highlighted row.

2\. Where each role lands and what the home screen links to
===========================================================

After sign-in every user lands on /home (or on the page they were trying to open). The sidebar shows only the modules their scopes allow. Each home widget is a link; the destination is shown below.

| **Role** | **Home widgets → destination** |
| --- | --- |
| Super Admin | Pending invitations → /admin/users?status=invited · Suspended users → /admin/users?status=suspended · Permission changes this week → /admin/audit?entity=core.profiles · Failed jobs and backup status → /admin/jobs · Security alerts (lockouts, MFA resets) → /admin/audit?action=security |
| Management | Approvals waiting → /approvals · Shipments delayed → /imports/shipments?filter=delayed · Below reorder → /inventory/reorder · Units by stage → /production/board · Orders awaiting approval or dispatch → /sales/orders?status=pending\_approval · Margin trend → /reports/margin · Budget position → /finance/budgets · Exceptions → /reports/exceptions |
| Procurement & Imports | Open POs → /procurement/orders?status=open · Shipments by stage → /imports/shipments?view=board · Held at customs → /imports/shipments?status=held · Free days ≤ 3 → /imports/shipments?filter=demurrage · Charges awaiting actuals → /imports/shipments?filter=estimated\_charges · My requisitions → /procurement/requisitions?mine=1 |
| Inventory & Sales | Receipts expected today → /inventory/receipts?due=today · Reorder suggestions → /inventory/reorder?tab=suggestions · Buildable now → /production/buildable · Orders ready to dispatch → /sales/orders?status=ready · Counts due → /inventory/counts?due=1 · Orders awaiting materials → /production/orders?status=awaiting\_materials |
| Finance & Service | Invoices to issue → /finance/invoices?tab=to\_issue · Unallocated payments → /finance/payments?tab=unallocated · Aged receivables → /reports/receivables-aging · Tickets by SLA → /service/tickets?view=sla · Supplier invoices to match → /procurement/invoices?status=draft · Period close checklist → /finance/periods |
| Assembly Technician | My queue (cards for assigned units) → /production/queue · Blocked units → /production/queue?filter=blocked · Repairs assigned to me → /service/tickets?assigned=me |
| QC Inspector | Units awaiting inspection → /quality/inspections?tab=units · Incoming inspections → /quality/inspections?tab=incoming · Rework ready for retest → /quality/rework?status=done |

3\. Sign-in, shell and shared pages
===================================

### Sign in

**Route** /login **Access** anyone **From** a bookmark, email deep link or session expiry **Leads to** /login/mfa

| **Control** | **Shown to · enabled when** | **Result** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Email, Password | all | Typed values; password field has a show/hide toggle |
| Sign in | all · both fields filled | Correct details → /login/mfa. Wrong details → generic message “Email or password is incorrect”; after 5 failures the account locks for 15 minutes and the Super Admin gets an alert \[N\] |
| Forgot password | all | → /reset |
| Suspended user | — | Correct password still shows “Your account is not active. Contact the administrator.”; no session is created |

### Second step: authenticator code

**Route** /login/mfa **Access** signed-in-halfway **From** /login **Leads to** /home or the original deep link

| **Control** | **Shown to · enabled when** | **Result** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Six-digit code, Verify | all | Correct → session starts, lands on target. Wrong → error, 5 wrong in 10 minutes locks the account |
| Use a recovery code | all | Swaps the field for a recovery code; the code is burnt after use and the user is told how many remain |
| Back to sign in | all | → /login |

### Accept invitation and set up

**Route** /accept-invite **Access** invited user (email link, valid 72 hours) **From** invitation email **Leads to** /home

| **Control** | **Shown to · enabled when** | **Result** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Create account | new user · password meets rules | Saves password → step 2 (authenticator setup) |
| Scan QR / enter key, Verify and continue | new user | Correct code → recovery codes shown once |
| Download codes, “I have saved my codes” | new user · after download or copy | Profile becomes active; session starts → /home |
| Expired link | — | Page explains the link expired and asks the user to request a new invitation from the Super Admin |

### Password reset

**Route** /reset **Access** anyone **From** /login › Forgot password **Leads to** email link → /reset/\[token\] → /login

| **Control** | **Shown to · enabled when** | **Result** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Send reset link | all | Always answers “If the email exists, a link was sent” \[E\]. Link valid 30 minutes |
| Set new password (on token page) | valid token | Saves, revokes all other sessions, → /login. MFA is still required at next sign-in |

| Approvals badge | users with approvals | → /approvals |

### Approvals inbox

**Route** /approvals **Access** any approver; everyone sees own requests **From** bell, home widget, email link **Leads to** the source document

| **Control** | **Shown to · enabled when** | **Result** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tabs: Pending for me · Requested by me · Decided | all | Switches list; counts shown on tabs |
| Row (opens detail drawer) | all | Shows requester, amount, currency, reason, rule matched, attachments, history of similar past requests, and “Open document” |
| Open document | all | → the PO, adjustment, order, expense, period, bank change or reversal concerned |
| Approve | approver · request pending · approver ≠ requester | Optional comment. Request becomes approved and the action runs (table in section 15). Requester \[N\] \[E\] |
| Reject | approver · request pending | Comment required. Request becomes rejected; document returns to its prior editable state with the comment shown. Requester \[N\] \[E\] |
| Cancel request | requester · pending | Request becomes cancelled; document returns to draft |
| Escalation (automatic) | — | If no decision within the rule’s SLA the request moves to the delegate and both are notified \[N\] \[E\] |

### BOM editor

**Route** /catalog/boms/\[id\] **Access** bom.write (IS) to edit; bom.approve (MG) to approve **From** item detail › New version **Leads to** item detail

| Save draft | bom.write · draft | Saves; status draft |

### Purchase order

**Route** /procurement/orders/new → /procurement/orders/\[id\] **Access** procurement.write (PI; IS limited), approve: procurement.approve (MG) **From** requisition, supplier page, orders list **Leads to** shipments, receipts, invoices

| **Control** | **Shown to · enabled when** | **Result** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Supplier, Currency, Incoterm, Mode, Dates, Terms | PI · draft | Currency defaults to supplier’s; exchange rate is filled from /admin/settings rates for today. If no rate exists the form shows “Add today’s rate” (FS or SA) |
| Add line / Remove line | PI · draft | Item search (only purchasable items), quantity, unit price; line and PO totals update; estimated duty appears on the Duty tab from HS codes and tariffs |
| Save draft | PI · draft | Status draft, PO number assigned at first save |
| Submit for approval | PI · draft · supplier active · rate present · at least one line | Status pending\_approval if the rule applies (amount or supplier aggregate over the window) \[AP\] \[N\] MG; otherwise approved |
| Withdraw | PI · pending approval | Back to draft, request cancelled |
| Approve / Reject | MG · pending (also in /approvals) | Approve → approved \[N\] PI. Reject → draft with comment \[N\] PI |
| Send to supplier | PI · approved | \[J\] PDF generated and emailed to supplier contact \[E\]; status sent; Resend and Download PDF become available |
| Record confirmation | PI · sent | Supplier reference and confirmed dates → confirmed |
| Amend | PI · approved, sent or confirmed | Creates a new version in draft; needs approval again; supplier notified only when re-sent |
| Create shipment | PI · confirmed or partly received | → /imports/shipments/new?po=\[id\] with open lines |
| Create goods receipt | IS, PI · confirmed or partly received | → /inventory/receipts/new?po=\[id\] (for local deliveries without a shipment) |
| Close PO | PI · fully received and invoices matched | Status closed |
| Close short | PI · partly received and no open shipment | Reason required; remaining quantity cancelled; approval if remaining value exceeds the rule \[AP\]; status closed |
| Cancel PO | PI · no posted receipts | Reason required; status cancelled; supplier notice optional \[E\] |
| Tabs Lines · Shipments · Receipts · Invoices · Duty · Documents · Timeline | read | Cross-links to related documents; received quantity per line is computed from posted receipts |

### Shipment tracker

**Route** /imports/shipments/\[id\] **Access** imports.write (PI); read MG, IS, FS **From** shipments list, PO page, landed-cost run, notifications **Leads to** receipts, landed cost, supplier invoices

| **Control** | **Shown to · enabled when** | **Result** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stage bar | all | Shows Booked → In transit → Arrived → Customs → Cleared → Delivered with ETA versus original ETA in days |
| Edit details | PI · not closed | Updates carrier, containers, BL/AWB and so on |
| Mark departed | PI · booked | Status in\_transit; event added |
| Add event | PI · not closed | Event type, place, time, note → timeline. Type “Arrived” sets actual arrival date, status arrived, starts the free-days clock |
| Update ETA | PI · booked or in transit | Stores the new ETA; if later than the original by more than the setting (default 3 days) \[N\] \[E\] MG, IS |
| Tab Lines › Add or edit line | PI · before arrival | Adjust quantities; cannot exceed open PO quantity |
| Tab Customs › Start customs entry | PI · arrived | Creates entry in draft with declaration number field |
| Tab Customs › Mark lodged / assessed / queried / paid / released | PI | Each button asks for its date and fields (assessed: customs value, duty, VAT, levies; queried: reason; paid: date and reference; released: date). Shipment status follows: lodged or assessed → customs\_processing, queried → held, released → cleared. Duty and levy amounts create or update charges as actual \[N\] on query |
| Mark held / Release hold | PI | Reason and owner required; shipment held / back to customs\_processing; \[N\] MG, IS |
| Tab Charges › Add charge | PI | Type, vendor, amount, currency, rate (auto, editable with reason), allocation basis, recoverable flag, invoice reference → status estimated |
| Tab Charges › Mark actual / Edit / Delete | PI · estimated, or actual before landed cost | Replace estimate with the invoiced figure; once a landed-cost run is posted, changes need a new run |
| Tab Documents › Upload | PI | Types: bill of lading/AWB, invoice, packing list, customs entry, release order, photo. File shows “Scanning” then “Clean”; infected files are blocked. Checklist shows which required documents are missing |
| Mark cleared | PI · customs released | Status cleared |
| Mark delivered | PI, IS · cleared | Status delivered; goods receipt draft created for IS with expected lines \[N\] IS → /inventory/receipts/\[id\] |
| Tab Receipts | read | Lists receipts linked to this shipment |
| Run landed cost | PI, FS (landedcost.post) · delivered · receipts posted · estimated charges either replaced or explicitly accepted | \[J\] creates a draft run → /imports/landed-cost/\[run\] |
| Close shipment | PI · landed cost posted · documents checklist complete · all charges actual | Status closed; no further edits except through reversal |
| Tab Timeline | read | Events (manual, carrier or agent) and audit entries |

### Landed-cost run

**Route** /imports/landed-cost/\[run\] **Access** landedcost.post (PI, FS) **From** shipment tracker **Leads to** shipment tracker, ledger

| **Control** | **Shown to · enabled when** | **Result** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Charges list with basis selector | PI, FS · draft | Change a charge’s basis (value, weight, volume, quantity) → Recalculate |
| Manual split | PI, FS · draft | Switch a charge to manual and type amounts per line; total must equal the charge |
| Recalculate | PI, FS · draft | Re-runs the allocation; table shows each line: goods value, share, added cost, new unit cost, effect on average cost |
| Post landed cost | PI, FS · draft · all lines allocated · period open | Confirmation lists what will change (lot cost, unit cost, average cost, accrual). On confirm: costs updated, cost history appended \[GL\] \[N\] FS, MG; status posted |
| Discard draft | PI, FS · draft | Run deleted; nothing posted |
| Reverse run | PI, FS · posted | Reason required; creates reversal run restoring prior costs \[GL\]; if the accounting period is closed the reversal needs Management approval \[AP\] |
| Export | PI, FS, MG | \[J\] allocation table as Excel |

14\. End-to-end click paths
===========================

Each path lists the page, the button pressed, and where the user lands. “→” means the next screen; bracketed notes say what changed.

14.1 Procure and import to stock and cost
-----------------------------------------

![Page flow procurement and imports](data:image/png;base64,)  
_Figure 1 — Pages and buttons from reorder to payment_

1.  IS on /home clicks **Reorder suggestions** → /inventory/reorder?tab=suggestions; selects rows → **Create requisition from selected** → /procurement/requisitions/\[id\] (draft).
2.  IS clicks **Submit** → submitted; if over the limit MG sees it in /approvals → **Approve** → approved \[N\] PI. Under the limit it is approved instantly.
3.  PI opens the requisition → **Convert to PO** → /procurement/orders/new?req=…; picks supplier, currency (rate auto-filled) → **Save draft** → **Submit for approval**. MG approves in /approvals (**Approve**).
4.  PI on /procurement/orders/\[id\] clicks **Send to supplier** → sent \[E\] supplier. After the supplier replies PI clicks **Record confirmation** → confirmed.
5.  When goods ship, PI clicks **Create shipment** → /imports/shipments/new?po=… → fills BL/AWB, ETD, ETA → **Create shipment** → tracker (booked). PI uses **Mark departed**, **Add event**, **Update ETA**.
6.  On arrival: **Add event › Arrived** → arrived; **Start customs entry** → enter declaration; **Mark lodged**, **Mark assessed** (duty, VAT, levies create actual charges), **Mark paid**, **Mark released**; then **Mark cleared**.
7.  PI adds agent, freight and other invoices under **Charges › Add charge** (or marks estimates actual) and uploads documents under **Documents › Upload**.
8.  PI clicks **Mark delivered** → receipt draft created \[N\] IS. IS opens /inventory/receipts/\[id\], scans items, captures serials, rejects damage, **Request inspection** if required (QI records **Accept** or **Reject** in /quality/inspections/\[id\]), then **Post receipt** \[L\].
9.  PI or FS clicks **Run landed cost** on the shipment → /imports/landed-cost/\[run\] → review allocation → **Post landed cost** \[GL\]. Lot and unit costs now include freight, duty and clearing.
10.  FS opens /procurement/invoices → **New supplier invoice** → **Run match** → **Approve for payment** → **Record payment** → /finance/payments/new → record → supplier invoice paid \[GL\].
11.  PI clicks **Close shipment** once documents are complete and charges are actual.

14.2 Build, test, pass and hold in stock
----------------------------------------

![Page flow build to dispatch](data:image/png;base64,)  
_Figure 2 — Pages and buttons from BOM to handover_

1.  IS opens /catalog/boms/\[id\] → **Submit for approval**; MG **Approve** → BOM active.
2.  IS on /production/orders → **New assembly order** → picks model, quantity, purpose → **Save draft** → **Plan** → **Check materials**. If short: **Create requisition for shortage** (back to 14.1) and the order waits at awaiting\_materials; when stock arrives IS clicks **Check materials** again → ready.
3.  IS clicks **Release** → units created and reserved materials \[N\] AT; then **Issue materials** → scans component serials → **Post issue** \[L\] → order in\_progress.
4.  AT on /production/queue clicks a unit (or **Claim next unit**) → /production/units/\[id\]; works through **Start step**, checklist, **Scan component installed**, **Complete step**; **Record imaging**; **Record test** (POST, burn-in passed).
5.  AT clicks **Submit for QC** → qc\_hold \[N\] QI.
6.  QI opens /quality/inspections/\[id\] (not the builder): checks spec versus actual; **Pass** → serial assigned, cost snapshot, label printed, finished-goods receipt \[L\] \[GL\] → unit in\_stock \[N\] IS. **Fail** → add defects → rework order \[N\] AT → AT **Start rework**, **Mark fixed**, retest, **Submit for QC** again.
7.  When every unit is done the assembly order closes completed automatically; IS reads yields on the order and on /quality/defects.

14.3 Order, dispatch, invoice, payment, warranty
------------------------------------------------

1.  IS on /sales/orders → **New order** → account, source reference, lines → **Save draft** → **Submit**. Over-limit discounts go to MG (**Approve**); otherwise approved.
2.  IS clicks **Reserve units** (pick serials) or **Request build** (creates an assembly order; later finalised units auto-reserve and the order becomes ready).
3.  IS clicks **Create dispatch** → /sales/dispatches/new?order=… → **Add units** by scan → **Mark picked** → **Dispatch** \[L\] → units dispatched \[N\] FS.
4.  At the recipient IS clicks **Record handover**, captures name, phone, signature → delivered; warranty starts \[N\] FS \[E\] account contact.
5.  FS on /finance/invoices?tab=to\_issue → **New invoice** → **Issue** \[GL\] \[E\]; later **Record payment** → /finance/payments/new → **Allocate** → invoice paid.
6.  Month end: FS runs **Close checklist** on /finance/periods, **Request close**; MG **Approve** → period closed.

14.4 Warranty claim, repair and supplier recovery
-------------------------------------------------

![Page flow service](data:image/png;base64,)  
_Figure 3 — Pages and buttons for after-sales_

1.  FS opens /service/warranties, scans the serial: status, genealogy and supplier coverage appear → **Open ticket** → /service/tickets/new?unit=… → **Create ticket** (received) → **Assign to** a technician \[N\] AT.
2.  AT opens the ticket from /home → **Start diagnosis** → **Save diagnosis and coverage**. Covered → continue. Not covered → FS **Create quote** → **Send quote to account** → **Record approval** (or **Record decline**). Goodwill → request goes to MG in /approvals.
3.  AT **Add part** (scan) → **Consume parts** \[L\] → **Start repair** → **Retest** → FS **Mark ready for collection** \[E\].
4.  If a faulty component is in supplier warranty: **Open supplier RMA** → PI **Submit to supplier** → **Record authorisation** → **Mark shipped** → **Record credit note** or **Record replacement**.
5.  FS **Record collection** → ticket closed; billable tickets continue to **New invoice** (14.3).

14.5 Administration and control
-------------------------------

1.  SA on /admin/users → **Invite user** → user opens email → /accept-invite → password → authenticator → /home.
2.  SA changes scopes with **Edit scopes** (diff shown) → MG is emailed. Leaver: **Suspend** → sessions end at once.
3.  MG proposes limits; SA sets them in /admin/approval-rules and checks with **Test rule**.
4.  Go-live data: SA, PI or IS use /admin/imports → **Download template** → **Upload** → **Validate** → **Commit**; then IS runs a supervised stock take under /inventory/counts.
5.  Review: SA or MG open /admin/audit to trace any change; SA watches /admin/jobs for failures.

15\. What happens when an approval is decided
=============================================

| **Request type** | **Raised by button** | **On Approve** | **On Reject** | **Who decides** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Requisition (over limit) | Submit (requisition) | Status approved; PI can Convert to PO | Back to draft with comment | MG |
| Purchase order | Submit for approval | Status approved; Send to supplier unlocks | Back to draft | MG (procurement.approve) |
| Supplier bank change | Verify (after request) | New details applied; payments unblocked | Request closed; payments stay blocked until resolved | MG after FS verification |
| BOM version | Submit for approval (BOM) | Version active, previous retired | Back to draft | MG (bom.approve) |
| Stock adjustment / write-off | Submit (adjustment) | Posted \[L\] \[GL\] | rejected | MG (inventory.adjust.approve) |
| Internal order discount or credit exception | Submit (order) | Order approved | Back to draft | MG (orders.approve) |
| Return | Submit (return) | Receive return unlocks | rejected | MG (returns.approve) |
| Payment to supplier / variance invoice | Record payment or Approve for payment | Payment cleared \[GL\] | Back to approved/draft | MG (payments.approve) |
| Expense | Submit (expense) | Mark paid unlocks | rejected | MG (expenses.approve) |
| Goodwill repair / warranty extension | Save diagnosis or Extend warranty | Coverage recorded or end date moved | Declined | MG (service.approve / warranty.override) |
| Landed-cost reversal in closed period | Reverse run | Reversal posts | Run stays posted | MG |
| Period close / reopen | Request close / reopen | Period closed / open | Stays as is | MG (gl.close\_period) |
| QC conditional | Conditional (inspection) | Unit proceeds with defect noted (override) | Unit returns to rework | MG (qc.override) |

18\. Blocked buttons and what the user sees
===========================================

| **Situation (code)** | **Message shown** | **What the user can do next** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Serial reserved or sold (UNIT\_UNAVAILABLE) | “This unit is already reserved or sold.” with where | Pick another unit or release the reservation (IS) |
| Inspector worked on the unit (INSPECTOR\_BUILT\_UNIT) | “You worked on this unit and cannot inspect it.” | Another QI inspects; MG may reassign |
| Tests missing (TESTS\_INCOMPLETE) | “POST and burn-in must pass before QC.” | AT records the missing tests |
| QC not passed (QC\_NOT\_PASSED) | “A passed inspection is required to finalise.” | QI completes inspection |
| Serial missing (SERIAL\_REQUIRED) | “Serials are required for this item.” | Capture serials |
| Receipt already posted (GRN\_ALREADY\_POSTED) | “Already posted at \[time\] by \[name\].” | Open the posted receipt |
| No accepted lines (NO\_ACCEPTED\_LINES) | “No accepted stock on this shipment’s receipts.” | Post receipts first |
| No allocation basis (NO\_BASIS\_FOR\_CHARGE) | “Charge cannot be allocated by weight: no weights recorded.” | Change basis or enter weights |
| Period closed (PERIOD\_CLOSED) | “This accounting period is closed.” | Post in the current period or request reopen (FS) |
| Unbalanced journal (ENTRY\_UNBALANCED) | “Debits and credits differ by \[amount\].” | Correct lines |
| Approval required | “Sent to \[approver\] for approval.” status shown | Wait, or Withdraw |
| Own approval | “You cannot approve your own request.” | Ask another approver |
| Edit conflict (412) | “Updated by \[name\] at \[time\].” | Reload or Compare |
| Missing scope (403) | “You need \[capability\] for this.” | Request access (emails SA) |
| Missing exchange rate | “No rate for \[currency\] on \[date\].” | Add rate (SA, FS) |
| Supplier bank change pending | “Payments to this supplier are paused until the bank change is approved.” | Complete verification and approval |
| Account on hold | “This account is on hold.” | Reactivate (IS, FS) |
| Credit limit exceeded | “Order exceeds the account’s credit limit.” (submits for approval) | Continue to approval or reduce lines |

================================================

19.1 Phase 2 and later controls on these pages
----------------------------------------------

| **Control** | **Phase** |
| --- | --- |
| Supplier RMA buttons, supplier invoice three-way match, landed-cost automation beyond run and post | 2 |

| Repair knowledge base, forecasting, API clients for new apps | 3 |

19.2 Screen-level behaviours defined in this document (please confirm)
----------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Requisitions, adjustments and expenses below the rule limit are approved or posted without Management; above it they wait for approval.
2.  Suppliers are activated by the Procurement Officer after a checklist; bank changes need Procurement, Finance verification and Management approval.
3.  “Close short” on a partly received PO needs a reason and, above the limit, approval.
4.  A “Conditional” QC result holds the unit until Management overrides or sends it back; there is no separate approval type.
5.  Expenses can be submitted by every staff member for themselves; only Finance marks them paid.
6.  Technicians see only the units assigned to them or claimed from the queue; planners see all.
7.  Documents emailed to account contacts (invoice, quote, ready for collection, delivery confirmation) contain no login link; contacts do not use the system.
8.  Landed cost can be posted only after receipts are posted; estimates may be accepted explicitly with a note.

_If any of these differ from how the unit actually works, change the rule here first; the PRD, API and schema already allow each variant._
